title: Flower Field
description: An interactive 3D procedural flower field simulation built with Three.js, featuring dynamic botanical generation, realistic wind-swaying grass blade animations, raycasted petal burst particle effects, and customizable field parameters.
Highlights: Procedural flower generation modeling organic variations in stem height, petal count, circular distribution, and randomized vibrant color palettes
Dynamic grass field simulation generating individual blade meshes animated with harmonic wind sway vectors and adjustable wind velocity
Interactive raycasted particle effect triggering 3D burst physics and velocity-driven dispersal of flower petals upon ground clicks
Real-time control panel interface enabling dynamic regeneration and parameter bounds validation across flower and grass densities
